QUOTE: "`freshness.notices()` turns each tripped axis into a `{axis, message}` pair. It returns an empty list when the index is current, so a current index adds nothing to a reply." and "Every query reply carries a `staleness` block when any axis is tripped."

VERDICT: MISS

WHY: The answer says every query reply carries the block only when an axis is tripped, and that a current index adds nothing. It never says the annotation rides on every reply without being asked for.
